en.headline: Observatory issues thunderstorm warning valid until 1:30pm
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory warned of isolated thunderstorms until 1:30pm, with heavier showers expected in some districts over the next hour or two.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a Thunderstorm Warning at 11:50am on Friday, valid until 1:30pm. It said isolated thunderstorms were expected over Hong Kong.

In a weather report issued at 11:51am, the Observatory said showers and thunderstorms linked to an upper-air disturbance were developing around the Pearl River Estuary, and that rain could be heavier in some parts of the city over the next one to two hours. At 11am the Observatory recorded 31 degrees and relative humidity of 73 per cent.

The Observatory advised people outdoors to seek shelter, to leave the water and not to swim or take part in other outdoor water sports, and to stay off high ground and away from conductive objects, trees and masts.
The warning is separate from the morning Thunderstorm Warning that covered parts of the New Territories earlier on Friday. Members of the public were asked to watch for further changes.

zh.headline: 天文台發出雷暴警告 有效至下午1時30分
zh.dek: 天文台警告本港有局部雷暴，有效至下午1時30分，並指未來一兩小時部分地區雨勢可能較大。
body: 香港天文台星期五上午11時50分發出雷暴警告，有效至下午1時30分，預料香港有局部地區雷暴。
天文台在上午11時51分的天氣報告表示，與高空擾動相關的駱雨及雷暴正在珠江口一帶發展，預料未來一兩小時本港部分地區雨勢較大。上午11時，天文台錄得氣溫31度，相對濕度百分之73。
天文台提醒，雷暴發生時如身處室外應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿在戶外游泳或進行其他戶外水上運動，亦切勿站立於高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
今次警告有別於星期五早上針對新界部分地區發出的雷暴警告。天文台呼籲市民留意天氣變化。
